method: Actual isolated process scene responses passed through the exact candidate input-validation rules; category counts compared with frozen layout, camera alias normalized. Program source freezes initial assignments, but loop bound is6 regardless of initial item count.
limits: Object-count deficit does not prove an individual detection false negative without image/identity review.
Returned object numeric suffixes are not assumed persistent identities.
This is an analysis-only comparison to layout truth, never a policy input.
Latent coverage limits may not explain a run that already stops on an earlier planning failure.
Missing first-view categories do not prove the underlying vision model cannot detect them in another view.
